item.title: Run, Lav, run! Lavner's Running of the Bros to 16 at Scottsdale
item.description: Ryan Lavner did the Running of the Bros to the 16th hole at TPC Scottsdale. He managed to survive, but not without a few barbs from Damon Hack and Eamon Lynch on "Golf Today."

item.title: Brooks Koepka gets a warm reception in PGA Tour return. It might have been about more than him
item.description: Koepka would never consider anything a dream week without a trophy, certainly not a tie for 56th finishing 19 shots behind the winner. But it felt like one at Torrey Pines.

item.title: This one's for Fooch: The added significance of Justin Rose's record Farmers win
item.description: Sunday's victory was meaningful to Rose beyond breaking the tournament's scoring record. He had his longtime looper at his side, and that wasn't the case when he won seven years ago.

item.title: Polls loving Glover? Adam Scott not confident he'll be next PAC chair
item.description: Adam Scott and Lucas Glover are part of the 16-man Player Advisory Council, and they were selected to run for PAC chairman.

item.title: Marco Penge 'too casual' in home club hunt? His attire didn't help
item.description: Marco Penge found that a few clubs did not seem terribly inviting, and he was happy to find the atmosphere he wanted at Old Palm. It probably didn't help his cause to show up with shorts and a T-shirt.

item.title: 'I own that, and I’m sorry': LPGA commish takes responsibility for TOC call, confusion
item.description: LPGA commissioner Craig Kessler has apologized to his membership following the controversial cancellation of Sunday’s final round of the season-opening Hilton Grand Vacations Tournament of Champions.

item.title: 'The punishing stretch': Drone flyover of Nos. 7-12 at TPC Scottsdale
item.description: Take an aerial look at hole Nos. 7-12 at TPC Scottsdale, which Paige Mackenzie calls, "the punishing stretch of the golf course."

item.title: Bubbie, Dalke preview Good Good Desert Open with country stars
item.description: Bubbie Broders and Brad Dalke of Good Good Golf join "Golf Central" to preview Wednesday's Good Good Desert Open, which features teams comprised of country music stars.
